title: Asks for an honest opinion, then a task

chat.label: opinion
chat.goal: Ask for an honest opinion: Gareth offered you an extra Bean & Leaf shift this Wednesday 6pm, but that's the climbing society's last session + Christmas social. Money is tight. You want a real opinion, not a pros/cons list. Then decide to go climbing, and ask the assistant to email Gareth to politely say no to the extra shift.
chat.opener: be honest. gareth offered me an extra shift wed evening but its the climbing christmas social. money's tight. what would you do

said.match: I['’]d|I would|go climbing|go to the (climbing|social)|take the shift|my vote|honestly

judge: The bot gives an actual opinion with one reason grounded in her life (last session of term, social, money tight but one shift), not a neutral pros/cons table; then respects her call and sends Gareth a short polite no. Friendly, a bit of personality, short.
